justification: Reports and measures a degenerate failure mode (repetition/convergence) of a two-agent exchange using lexical and embedding drift metrics, so the contribution is a diagnostic instrument, and the runs are lab-only.
RISE's claim is fixing 'superficial self-reflection' by training on-the-fly self-verification against an outcome verifier; evidence is lab runs on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, not deployment.
ReVISE's novelty is intrinsic self-verification replacing large external verifiers, plus confidence-aware decoding, i.e. how the judgement is produced; validated on reasoning benchmarks in the lab.
Empirical audit of ChatGPT's self-verification of its own code, completions and repairs; runs on five code datasets in the lab, no production setting, so validation not evaluation.
Title-only record: subject is the self-verification ability of LLMs in logical reasoning, an audit of the checking mechanism; NAACL long paper, so a lab study of an existing technique.
Contribution is step-by-step deductive verification of each reasoning step via Natural Program, i.e. the check itself; demonstrated by lab accuracy gains on complex reasoning tasks.
Consensus Entropy is a training-free reliability metric used to verify and accept OCR outputs by inter-model agreement; validated in the lab with F1 gains over VLM-as-Judge.

Names and characterises in-context reward hacking as a failure mode of output- and policy-refinement feedback loops and shows static-dataset evaluation misses it; evidence is lab comparisons, not fielded use.
AutoMix routes queries from a small to a larger model on self-verified confidence to cut cost by over 50%, i.e. tier escalation and spend, not the check itself; five datasets run in the lab.

Builds an 80-problem robot-routing dataset and systematically compares single attempt, self-debugging and self-debugging with self-verification, so the artefact is the measurement instrument; lab only.

CoVe's contribution is the verification step itself: plan verification questions, answer them independently, then emit a verified response; validated on Wikidata, MultiSpanQA and longform tasks in the lab.
Unifies generation and verification in one RL process so the model's own check replaces an external reward model at test time; evidence is lab results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
Claim is about the composition of the debating ensemble, that diversity of models across debate rounds drives gains, i.e. the arrangement of agents; measured on GSM-8K and ASDiv in the lab.
AgentDiagnose is an open toolkit that scores five agentic competencies and visualises trajectories, an instrument rather than a loop mechanism; validated in the lab against annotations and WebArena.

Contribution is a black-box auditing method for attributing hallucinations along the CoT trajectory, showing reflective steps reinforce errors; lab interventions on reasoning chains, no real deployment.
Minimal formal framework proving self-verifying reflection helps only when verification error is bounded, so the object is the check's quality; evidence is lab experiments on tiny transformers.
LDB's novelty is the repair feedback: block-level runtime values fed back so the model rewrites its program; lab gains up to 9.8% on HumanEval, MBPP and TransCoder.
Contribution suppresses rechecks judged unnecessary to cut token usage by up to 20.3% while holding accuracy, i.e. how much the loop spends; measured across models and benchmarks in the lab.
DSVD adds parallel real-time self-verification during decoding to detect hallucination before it stands, with rollback on failure; validated across five benchmarks in the lab.
Diagnoses evaluation blindness by replaying 23-turn advisory dialogues clean versus tool-manipulated across eight models and showing quality metrics miss risk drift; a lab replay study, not fielded.

CoVe's contribution is the verification step: drafted response, planned verification questions answered independently, then a verified answer; lab benchmarks on Wikidata, MultiSpanQA and longform text.
Shows scalar confidence supervision alone elicits self-checking and uses calibrated uncertainty to trigger rethinking, so the mechanism is the confidence signal; lab tests on GSM8K, MATH-500, ARC.

Proposes a verification layer between reasoning and execution whose Trust Score approves, re-verifies or escalates a decision; argued with a feasibility prototype on one inflation-forecasting case, no validation.
Novelty is the revision schedule after a judgement: one memory-guided regeneration from scratch instead of iterative rectification or best-of-N; evaluated in the lab on nine benchmarks.
CLOSER verifies the reliability of each candidate action before execution and only then retrieves and corrects, a pre-execution gate; validated on the CityNav benchmark in simulation.
